limitations: Only rotate and bob are implemented; general programs, interaction triggers and physics remain proposed
Animation phase is not persisted; restored paused behavior starts at baseline phase
Animated swept volumes are not collision checked; rotation may intersect physical surfaces
Nonuniformly scaled parents can deform rotating visuals
No arbitrary generated C# execution, autonomous navigation or artificial AR locomotion
The voice room-loading status can remain after room readiness; current room state and outlines must be checked. This cosmetic status issue is documented but not changed in the installed build.
